claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let R(n) be the sum of the monomials in guarantee.remainder.terms, each coefficient times n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent; an empty sum is zero. There exists N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-R(n) for every integer n>=N. All remainder coefficients are the exact declared constants. experiments.purpose: Exact integer/Fraction calibration of the selected structured-affine breaker and unchanged circuit-family accounting. Recomputes all selected affine AK and ordinary primitive envelopes, inner and outer slots, source/seed/density/rank-budget scalars, literal AK fields and padded seeds, actual F# and NB caller dimensions, sampler/base witnesses, both H branches and the exact logarithmic coefficient. With the complete package present also checks parameter text, evidence hashes and canonical metadata; isolated source-only execution explicitly skips those package checks. A finite witness for displayed constants and guards only: this computation does not prove the new common-affine source invariant, generated-auxiliary conditioning or tampered-call flattening theorem, execute the full family, or certify the universal circuit proof.
